title: Seed script exits successfully without seeding any sources
reasoning: The script selects an endpoint and fetches the current source list, and it defines create_source, but no code invokes create_source or otherwise mutates configuration before printing Done. Any workflow using this seed script as an automation step will get a successful exit even though no seed data was applied.
recommendation: Either call the intended seeding logic before printing Done, or rename/replace the script with an explicit validation/no-op script so callers cannot mistake it for a successful seed operation.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included for this shell workflow, and there is no assertion that running the script creates or updates expected sources.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an integration test or shell-level smoke test with a mock HTTP server that runs scripts/seed-agent-sources.sh and asserts the expected POST request(s) are made, or asserts no-op behavior if that is the intended contract.
minimumFixScope: Add the missing top-level seeding calls or remove the misleading unused seeding functions and update the script contract.
